name: Equip
desc:
Caregiver Coach - PT after 2 PM | $54K - $65K + 15% annual bonus potential (roughly $26 - $31/hr estimate) | Admin, No Sales Expectations
Company: Equip Health
Industry: Healthcare / Behavioral Health, Eating Disorder Treatment
What Your Day Will Look Like:
You'd be the go-to support person for parents and caregivers whose loved one is going through eating disorder treatment. Your job is to help those caregivers actually follow through on the care plan, whether that means coaching them through tough moments, running skills based sessions, or problem solving the everyday stuff that gets in the way, like scheduling, groceries, or school accommodations. You're part coach, part care coordinator, checking in proactively, tracking engagement, and building real trust with families over time. It's relationship driven work with a genuine specialty behind it, not a general call center role.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not specified in the posting
Required Experience: 2+ years of experience working with families in a healthcare setting, such as coaching, case management, mentorship, social work, or milieu therapy. Also requires personal lived experience supporting a loved one through eating disorder recovery, currently in firm and stable recovery
Preferred Experience: Not specified beyond required qualifications
Required Skills:
Strong oral and written communication and relationship building
Strong organization and time management with a track record of meeting goals
Comfort learning new technology and working on camera
Ability to think critically and work through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment
Attention to detail and consistent, compliant documentation
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A participant who has personal lived experience supporting a loved one through eating disorder recovery and feels ready to bring that into professional coaching work
Someone with 2+ years in a coaching, case management, mentorship, or family support role
Someone who thrives in relationship based work and enjoys helping people follow through on a plan
Someone comfortable being on camera and working a schedule that includes some evening and afternoon hours
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone without the specific lived experience requirement listed above, this is a defining qualification for the role
Anyone without 2+ years of relevant family or healthcare support experience
Anyone who needs a strict 9 to 5 schedule, since this role includes required evening and afternoon availability
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Family coaching
Case management
Care plan adherence
Behavioral health
Patient engagement
Motivational strategies
Documentation compliance
Relationship building
Healthcare coordination
Telehealth
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about a time you helped someone follow through on a plan they were struggling to stick with.
How would you describe your approach to building trust with a family who is new to treatment?
Walk us through how you'd handle a caregiver who keeps missing scheduled sessions.
What draws you to this specific area of coaching, and how does your background prepare you for it?
How do you stay organized when managing a full caseload of ongoing relationships?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $54,000 to $65,000 base pay per year plus up to 15% annual performance-based bonus potential, roughly $26 to $31 per hour as an estimate
Shift: Full time with 33 hours a week of direct patient care required, including two evenings a week until 8pm (chosen by the coach) and at least 20 hours a week after 2pm in the patient's local time zone. Also requires attendance at mandatory internal meetings
Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, life, and AD&D insurance with a significant employer contribution, flexible PTO plus 11 paid holidays, generous parental leave, 401K, mental health benefits including free therapy and coaching sessions, student loan repayment assistance, and continuing education support
Equipment Provided: Yes. Company provides a laptop plus a $50 per month home internet stipend, an initial work from home stipend of up to $500, and periodic stipend reloads over time
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a meaningful opportunity for a participant who has walked alongside a loved one through eating disorder recovery and wants to turn that lived experience into a career helping other families do the same. The benefits package here is genuinely strong, especially the mental health and continuing education perks, and the pay range is solid for a remote coaching role. This one is best suited for a specific participant profile rather than a broad audience, given the lived experience and prior coaching or case management background required.
Career Pathway: Caregiver Coach → Senior Caregiver Coach → Care Team Lead or Clinical Program Coordinator
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
